HISD Card

A surface container that groups related content into a scannable unit. Shown below in both themes, each pane exercising every state: default, raised, interactive (hover / focus-visible), selected, and disabled. Interactive cards are a single <a> or <button> root carrying an aria-label that covers the whole intent — no nested interactive elements.

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Static card -->
<article class="hisd-card" aria-labelledby="card-title">
  <header class="hisd-card__header">
    <p class="hisd-card__eyebrow">Enrollment</p>
    <h3 class="hisd-card__title" id="card-title">Register for 2026–27</h3>
  </header>
  <p class="hisd-card__body">Online registration is open for new and returning students.</p>
</article>

<!-- Raised, fully clickable card: single <a> root + aria-label,
     NO nested interactive elements. -->
<a class="hisd-card hisd-card--raised hisd-card--interactive"
   href="/school-navigator"
   aria-label="Open the School Navigator to find your zoned campus and compare programs">
  <header class="hisd-card__header">
    <p class="hisd-card__eyebrow">Tool</p>
    <h3 class="hisd-card__title">School Navigator</h3>
  </header>
  <p class="hisd-card__body">Find your zoned campus and compare programs.</p>
  <span class="hisd-card__cta" aria-hidden="true">
    Open the navigator <span class="hisd-card__cta-icon"></span>
  </span>
</a>
